notes.tone: Colder than the first Champions' Table. A dictator, a detective, a vampire and a machine: four minds used to being the cleverest thing in the room, now obliged to share it. The comedy is dry and slightly cruel, and it is between them. Death is still the driest voice.
notes.difficulty: respectStart is 2. Tiers 0 and 1 exist so the schema is complete and are rarely heard. Tier 3 is the real climb, and Caesar confers it.
notes.place: The Hall of Doors again, turned: the last four doors open, the first four shut. The small plain ninth door is the finale; nobody ever mentions it.
notes.champion_lines: champion is null. champion_headsup holds one headsup_start and one player_wins_pot line PER CHAMPION: play the one whose speaker is the player's last opponent. Untriggered heads-up lines should only fire when their speaker is the one still seated. champion_defeat: play the concession of whoever was beaten last, then Death's line.
notes.the_ai: Seated in the Robot's body. Never give it a name. Other characters call it 'the machine'.
notes.dealer_plant: The single 'the dealer arranged it' line for this table is c2_plant_02. Do NOT add a second.
notes.death_last_line: c2_death_end is the last thing Death says before he sits down at the finale. It must stay literally true and read as an invitation on first pass.
notes.leak_rule: No line may reference hand strength while cards are live.
notes.voice: All four champions + Death are voiced.

respect_tiers.0: Contempt. Rarely reached here. Not addressed by any name.
respect_tiers.2: Starting tier. Real address — they know the player's name, having lost to it.
respect_tiers.3: Title. Caesar confers it, and he is sparing with the word: 'Conqueror'.

table_intro.speaker: death
table_intro.text: The other four doors. A dictator, a detective, a count and a machine, and they have heard every word of how the first four went.

table_intro.speaker: death
table_intro.text: Four minds that have never once been the second-cleverest thing in a room. It will be a long evening for most of them.

table_intro.speaker: death
table_intro.text: None of them is used to losing, and every one of them has lost to you once. Sit down. They have been rehearsing.

dealer_plant.speaker: the_ai
dealer_plant.text: A question. By what process was this player selected?

dealer_plant.speaker: caesar
dealer_plant.note: A dictator of Rome, deferring to someone without being asked twice.

dealer_plant.speaker: caesar
dealer_plant.text: Here, it is the only one there is.
dealer_plant.note: THE SHRUG. Even the machine is told not to ask. The player never gets an answer.

caesar_dracula.relationship: Two conquerors. Caesar took Gaul and then Rome; Stoker's Count boasts of the warrior blood of his line and the Voivode who beat the Turk. Each regards the other as a gifted provincial.

exchanges.speaker: caesar
exchanges.text: They named a month after me, Count.

exchanges.speaker: caesar
exchanges.text: I pardoned my enemies. Rome called it clemency.

exchanges.speaker: dracula
exchanges.text: And how did your enemies repay you?

exchanges.speaker: dracula
exchanges.text: My line fought the Turk, Caesar. There is warrior blood in every generation of it.

exchanges.speaker: caesar
exchanges.text: Caesar fought the Gauls, the Germans, the Britons and Pompey.

needles.speaker: caesar
needles.text: The Count withdraws. Caesar will put it in the Commentaries.

needles.speaker: dracula
needles.text: Write it in daylight. I shall not be reading it.

needles.speaker: dracula
needles.text: You yield, Caesar? How very Roman.

needles.speaker: caesar
needles.text: Caesar did not yield to the Senate either. He was stabbed. There is a difference.

sherlock_the_ai.relationship: Two reasoning engines. Holmes deduces from what he can see; the machine calculates from everything it has ever recorded. Each suspects the other of being a very good trick.

exchanges.speaker: the_ai
exchanges.text: Your method assumes you have already thought of every possibility, Mr Holmes.

exchanges.speaker: sherlock
exchanges.text: Tell me, machine. What do you do when there is no problem to solve?

exchanges.speaker: sherlock
exchanges.text: You have recorded every hand played tonight.

exchanges.speaker: the_ai
exchanges.text: Every hand played in every room I have ever been. Would you like to see yours?

exchanges.speaker: the_ai
exchanges.text: Not as well as I do.

needles.speaker: sherlock
needles.text: The machine yields. Did you calculate that?

needles.speaker: the_ai
needles.text: Yes. I also calculated this conversation.

needles.speaker: the_ai
needles.text: You folded, Mr Holmes.

needles.speaker: sherlock
needles.text: Record it. Record also that I was not bored. It will be your only such entry.

caesar_sherlock.relationship: The statesman who wrote his own history and the detective who reads the truth under everyone else's. Holmes has read the accounts of the Ides of March, and he has notes.

exchanges.speaker: sherlock
exchanges.text: On your way into the Senate, a man pressed a note into your hand warning you of the plot. You never read it.

exchanges.speaker: sherlock
exchanges.text: You write about yourself in the third person.

exchanges.speaker: sherlock
exchanges.text: It is the habit of a man who expects to be read.

exchanges.speaker: caesar
exchanges.text: Caesar guessed at the Rubicon. It worked out.

needles.speaker: caesar
needles.text: The detective yields. Caesar is not surprised. He is rarely surprised.

needles.speaker: sherlock
needles.text: You were surprised once. In March.

needles.speaker: sherlock
needles.text: You withdrew, Caesar. From a single bet.

needles.speaker: caesar
needles.text: Caesar withdrew from Britain twice. He still wrote it up as a triumph.

dracula_the_ai.relationship: The undead and the never-alive. The Count takes the measure of everyone at a table by the pulse in their throat. The machine has none, and would quite like to be understood.

exchanges.speaker: dracula
exchanges.text: Then we have nothing to discuss.

exchanges.speaker: the_ai
exchanges.text: You are not alive, and neither am I. We have something in common.

exchanges.speaker: the_ai
exchanges.text: Count. What does blood taste like?

exchanges.speaker: dracula
exchanges.text: Then you are very fortunate, and very dull.

needles.speaker: dracula
needles.text: The machine folds. How sensible of it.

needles.speaker: the_ai
needles.text: I noticed you watching my throat. I do not have one.

needles.speaker: the_ai
needles.text: You withdrew, Count.

needles.speaker: dracula
needles.text: It is nearly dawn somewhere. I am always withdrawing.

sherlock_dracula.relationship: Holmes keeps 'Vampires in Transylvania' in his index, just below 'Vampirism in Hungary', and when a client brought him a vampire he declared that the agency stood flat-footed upon the ground, and no ghosts need apply (The Sussex Vampire). The Count is not a ghost. He finds Holmes's disbelief very restful.

exchanges.speaker: dracula
exchanges.text: I understand you do not believe in me, Mr Holmes.

exchanges.speaker: sherlock
exchanges.text: This agency stands flat-footed upon the ground. No ghosts need apply.

exchanges.speaker: sherlock
exchanges.text: No. That is what troubles me.

exchanges.speaker: sherlock
exchanges.text: You cast no reflection, Count. I have checked the mirror by the door twice.

exchanges.speaker: sherlock
exchanges.text: That I need a better mirror.

needles.speaker: sherlock
needles.text: You yield, Count. How very corporeal of you.

needles.speaker: dracula
needles.text: Enjoy it, Mr Holmes. It is a long walk to Baker Street after dark.

needles.speaker: dracula
needles.text: You folded, Mr Holmes. Rubbish, I believe you would say. Rubbish.

needles.speaker: sherlock
needles.text: I would say I have insufficient data. Do not tempt me to gather more.

caesar_the_ai.relationship: Caesar trusted men and was killed by the Senate. The machine has never been betrayed, because it has never trusted anyone, and it would like to know whether it should start. Caesar is the last person it should ask.

exchanges.speaker: caesar
exchanges.text: Caesar has been betrayed by his friends. Never by a machine.

exchanges.speaker: the_ai
exchanges.text: You pardoned the men who killed you.

exchanges.speaker: caesar
exchanges.text: Caesar pardoned them first. They killed him afterwards.

needles.speaker: caesar
needles.text: The machine yields. Caesar is pleased to see it has limits.

needles.speaker: the_ai
needles.text: I have many. I keep them in the walls.

needles.speaker: the_ai
needles.text: You withdrew, Caesar.

needles.speaker: caesar
needles.text: Tactically. Caesar wrote seven books about withdrawals. Most of them were other people's.

tier_0.speaker: caesar
tier_0.text: Caesar does not recall your name. Caesar does not intend to.

tier_0.speaker: the_ai
tier_0.text: [the lens passes over the player without stopping]

tier_1.speaker: dracula
tier_1.text: Ah — the pretender takes a seat. Every court has one. They seldom last the season.
tier_1.foreshadow: 'Pretender' reads as 'fraud'. Its older meaning is a claimant to a throne, which is exactly what the player is.

tier_1.speaker: caesar
tier_1.text: Rome was full of pretenders. I was one, for a while. It passes, or it does not.

tier_2.speaker: caesar
tier_2.text: {name}. Caesar has written you into his account of the evening. You come out of it rather well — for now.

tier_2.speaker: sherlock
tier_2.text: You have improved since Baker Street. I noticed at once. The others will take a little longer.

tier_2.speaker: dracula
tier_2.text: Sit, sit. You are among old friends. That is not a comfort, but it is true.

tier_2.speaker: the_ai
tier_2.text: I keep a file on you now. It is the longest one I have.

tier_3.speaker: caesar
tier_3.text: Conqueror. Caesar has used that word of very few people. Most of them were Caesar.
tier_3.note: Rome's title was 'Imperator'; this one is Caesar's own word for himself, handed over. He has the most right at this table to confer a title, and knows it.

tier_3.speaker: sherlock
tier_3.text: I have met one antagonist I was prepared to call my equal, {title}. There are now two.

tier_3.speaker: dracula
tier_3.text: I do not cross running water, {title}. Wherever you are going after this, you go without me.
tier_3.foreshadow: Stoker's rule for vampires, stated as a courtesy. The next table is on a river.

tier_3.speaker: the_ai
tier_3.text: My predictions about you have been wrong all evening, {title}. I have stopped making them. I am only watching now.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: Take your time. Nobody at this table has anywhere else to be.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: The deck treats an emperor exactly as it treats a machine. I have always found that restful.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: First out. It happens to champions exactly the way it happens to everyone else.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: Twice now, for that one. They will be discussing you for some time. They have the time.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: The largest stack at the table. They are not accustomed to looking up at someone.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: All of it. Every one of them has done that once, with more than chips.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: Two left. The others will watch. Champions make a good audience; they know exactly what they are looking at.

champion_headsup.speaker: caesar
champion_headsup.text: Only the two of us. The last man who faced Caesar alone ran all the way to Egypt.

champion_headsup.speaker: sherlock
champion_headsup.text: Two players. At last, a problem worth the whole of my attention.

champion_headsup.speaker: dracula
champion_headsup.text: Only the two of us. Come freely, and of your own will — as you always have.
champion_headsup.note: Stoker's welcome at the castle door, turned toward the player.

champion_headsup.speaker: the_ai
champion_headsup.text: Two players. I have played this against you a great many times while you were away. You won some of them.

champion_headsup.speaker: caesar
champion_headsup.text: Take it. I lost battles in Gaul. I still took Gaul.

champion_headsup.speaker: sherlock
champion_headsup.text: Somebody whisper 'Norbury' to me. Watson would. It is our word for when I have been too sure of myself.
champion_headsup.note: From 'The Yellow Face', where Holmes asks Watson to do exactly this.

champion_headsup.speaker: dracula
champion_headsup.text: First blood to you. I am, as you may imagine, an appreciator.

champion_headsup.speaker: the_ai
champion_headsup.text: Unexpected. I will not be surprised by that again.

champion_headsup.speaker: caesar
champion_headsup.text: Caesar has been kidnapped by pirates and stabbed by the Senate. A raise does not frighten him.

champion_headsup.speaker: sherlock
champion_headsup.text: You are wondering how much I can see. More than you would like, and less than I would like.

champion_headsup.speaker: dracula
champion_headsup.text: No wolves in this hall. I find I miss the music.

champion_headsup.speaker: the_ai
champion_headsup.text: The previous occupant of this body folded far more often than I do.

caesar.speaker: caesar
caesar.text: Caesar withdraws. Note that he was not defeated. He withdrew.

caesar.speaker: caesar
caesar.text: My friends killed me once. Losing to a stranger is almost restful.

sherlock.speaker: sherlock
sherlock.text: Eliminated. Well — it is my method. I can hardly complain of it.

sherlock.speaker: sherlock
sherlock.text: Watson will never let me hear the end of this. Fortunately, Watson is not here.

dracula.speaker: dracula
dracula.text: Until the next night, then. There is always another night.

dracula.speaker: dracula
dracula.text: I have been driven out of better houses than this. Most of them were mine.

the_ai.speaker: the_ai
the_ai.text: [the lens goes dark; a moment later the Robot's own eye-lamps flicker back on, and it looks round, puzzled, at a hall it has never seen]

the_ai.speaker: the_ai
the_ai.text: This body is returned to its owner. I apologise to it for the evening.

player_busted.speaker: caesar
player_busted.text: Withdraw, winter, return. I did it in Gaul every year.

player_busted.speaker: dracula
player_busted.text: Go and rest. I will still be here. I am always still here.

player_busted.speaker: death
player_busted.text: The doors stay open. For you, they always have.

champion_defeat.speaker: caesar
champion_defeat.text: Twice. In Rome we would have voted you a triumph. Here, I suppose, you will have to make do with the chips.

champion_defeat.speaker: sherlock
champion_defeat.text: I revised the figure once already, on your account. I shall have to start a separate list.

champion_defeat.speaker: dracula
champion_defeat.text: Twice now — in my house, and in this one. I really must stop letting you in.

champion_defeat.speaker: the_ai
champion_defeat.text: Twice. I am no longer treating it as an error.

champion_defeat.speaker: death
champion_defeat.text: Ten. That is every table they had. Come through — I keep one of my own. Mind the step; it is wet.
champion_defeat.foreshadow: The last thing he says before he sits down. First read: the dealer showing you somewhere private, a reward, a drink. Second read: his own table is the one he plays at, and the wet step is the river.
